bio: Whether you opt for one of the seven seats up at the counter or for a regular table, there is no escaping EN's vibrancy. This energy is also reflected in the food. The set menus introduce you to creative Japanese dishes including an original take on tuna sashimi. The à la carte options, on the other hand, are more traditional. Whatever you choose, you can count on the characteristic finesse and richness for which this cuisine is world-renowned. The extensive sake selection is terrific....
